source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enter BMC-Web -> click "Power", and chck that it should access to "Server power operations".

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/Systems/system (PowerState) so user confirms the BMC web "power state" page shows the correct data. No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES substitutes a read-only Systems JSON query for the source's Power-icon navigation to Server power operations. It neither exercises the link nor proves the destination, uses insecure TLS/visible credentials and misses the nearby destructive power controls while labeling the operation no-risk.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly restores the UI path, strict navigation-only boundary, identity correlation and proof that power state did not change. This review retains that classification and treats API/UI PowerState parity as supporting evidence, not the source's primary acceptance.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 846/2291 accepts the API command despite its interface mismatch and performs only superficial syntax sanity; it supplies no protection against activating a power action.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No sequence-1009 draft exists in the invalidated 1,000-record run.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats build/account/route data as readiness rather than permanent blockage; ED-35 preserves the browser navigation interface and records API-only coverage differences; ED-38 requires explicit approval near power controls, no automatic retry and engineer-owned verdict.

original_test_intent: Verify the authenticated BMC web `Power` icon/link is present and navigates to the intended `Server power operations` view without executing, preselecting or submitting any host power action and without changing host/BMC state.
original_method: Bind the exact BMC/UI build, account and current host power state; locate the Power navigation icon by stable attributes; activate that navigation control once; verify the expected route/page completes without error; confirm every operation remains unselected/unsubmitted and host power/reachability/event state is unchanged.
manual_activity: An engineer identifies the exact navigation control and destination, approves a read-only account/browser plan and confirms that no power operation may be selected or submitted. The agent may automate the single navigation and state checks after approval; recovery and verdict remain engineer-owned.
required_inputs: Immutable BMC identity, trusted web URL/certificate, firmware/UI build and corresponding host identity
Supported browser/version and an approved account/role that can view the Power page without requiring operation privilege, with protected credentials/session
Stable Power icon accessible name/selector/location and expected Server power operations URL/SPA route/title/heading/DOM landmark

Inventory of every visible power/reset/cycle/NMI/graceful action control, default selection, form boundaries, confirmation dialog and whether the navigation icon is spatially or semantically separable
Current host power state, console/reachability observer, BMC power-event baseline and optional vendor-approved read-only System/PowerState resource
Exact no-submit interlock, click coordinate/selector verification, timeout, screenshot/DOM/network redaction, abort and independent OOB recovery
safety_requirements: This case is navigation-only. Do not select, focus through keyboard activation, submit, confirm or invoke any power on/off/reset/cycle/NMI/graceful operation, Redfish reset action or hidden form endpoint.
Use a stable semantic selector for the Power navigation link and verify its element type/target before the click. Do not use approximate coordinates near destructive controls.
Validate the BMC/host identity and capture power state/reachability before interaction. The page may be read-only in intent but has a host-wide blast radius if the wrong element is activated.
Do not use `/redfish/v1/Systems/system` JSON as proof that the UI link works. An approved read-only Systems resource may only support identity/state/no-change evidence.
Do not use `curl -k` or visible credentials; protect secrets and require browser/API identity correlation if supporting API evidence is collected.
Do not clear dmesg, syslog, SEL, BMC event or power logs. Those records are required to detect an unintended command.
Do not require PowerState parity as the sole or mandatory source criterion unless Project SPEC adds it; the source acceptance is the workable icon/link.

Do not automatically retry a failed/misdirected click. If any dialog opens, selection changes, request targets an action URI, host power/reachability changes or destination is uncertain, stop and preserve evidence; do not attempt an unapproved recovery power action.
agent_execution_scope: Before approval, bind BMC/host/build/account identity, record current host power/reachability/events and inspect the DOM to distinguish the navigation icon from every power-operation control without clicking.
After approval, activate only the verified navigation element once and capture the route/redirect, network request, page title/heading/landmark and final rendered/error/loading state.

Assert no operation option became selected, no confirmation dialog or action request was generated and no host power/reachability/event transition occurred; optionally compare the vendor-approved read-only PowerState as supplementary evidence.
Close the page/session, retain first-attempt UI/DOM/console/network/state evidence and report facts without submitting, retrying or issuing DUT PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the exact Power navigation selector, Server power operations destination, read-only account, destructive-control map and no-submit interlock.
Confirm the baseline/no-change observer and OOB response if an unintended action occurs; adjudicate ambiguous UI state.
Review navigation and no-power-action evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET is a potentially useful read-only state snapshot but cannot click or validate the Power link. Its hard-coded member path, `-k`, visible basic-auth form and full JSON return are not safe or portable, and it misses the destructive UI surface.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use supported browser automation with a prevalidated semantic selector and hard no-submit guard: record power state, click the Power navigation once, assert the Server power operations route/DOM, verify no action request/dialog/selection/state transition and capture redacted first-attempt evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Power icon, Server power operations destination, workable-link criterion, no Script and 5/0-minute estimates remain unmodified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Identity and power-state baseline; destructive-control DOM inventory; approved semantic navigation selector; one click; destination/error assertion; no-action network/UI/state checks; clean exit and OOB-ready evidence preservation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BMC firmware/UI build and account role exposing the Power navigation page.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC/UI build, browser/version, route/selector contract and optional read-only power-state resource version.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project/vendor BMC web navigation, power-control authorization and host power-state specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes `workable` measurable while isolating the link from adjacent destructive operations; it does not add an actual power-control test.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Systems JSON cannot prove navigation; a visible icon cannot prove destination; a rendered operations page does not authorize an action; PowerState comparison is supportive but not the source criterion.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Endpoint/build/account, selector/route, control map, no-submit guard, state observer, recovery and evidence rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A selector or focus error can power off/reset the host, terminate workloads and sever management; UI structure can change across builds.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may approve build-specific selectors, a read-only role and optional API no-change evidence, but an API-only query cannot replace the source browser navigation. Any actual power operation belongs to a separately approved testcase with exact action, active-workload checks and recovery.
expected_evidence: BMC/host identity, certificate, firmware/UI build, browser/version and redacted account/role
Pre-click DOM showing the Power navigation selector/target and separate inventory of destructive controls/default selections
Single-click timestamp, route/redirect/network chain and rendered Server power operations title/heading/landmark without errors
Proof no action URI/form was invoked, no confirmation/selection occurred and host power/reachability plus BMC/host event state remained unchanged
Optional trusted read-only PowerState before/after, redacted screenshot/DOM/console evidence, abort/recovery status and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define a Power icon whose expected destination is Server power operations and whose acceptance is workable navigation. The hazardous destination does not require executing any operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The navigation target and explicit no-operation boundary are understandable. Exact selectors, routes, account/build and recovery are supplyable inputs; with confirmation and interlocks the review can hand off safely without permanent blockage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes its API-only YES to package/user confirmation and rejects Systems JSON as link acceptance, while retaining it only as optional no-change evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on navigation-only classification, endpoint/state correlation and strict no-action boundary; strengthens selector/interlock and first-attempt abort evidence while keeping API parity optional.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-presence sanity with exact navigation-versus-action separation and host-wide blast-radius controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No prior invalid draft exists for this sequence.

review_improvement: Prevents both a harmless but irrelevant PowerState GET and an accidental destructive control click from being mistaken for the narrowly required Power-icon navigation test.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source asks only whether navigation works, but its destination is a control surface capable of immediately affecting the whole host. Therefore the correct test uses a semantic browser link assertion with a hard boundary around all operation controls. A read-only API state is useful to demonstrate no side effect, not to replace the browser path or broaden the test into power control.
